notionReferences: Optional on a scene (also accepted on an element or variant): [{ states?, when (default rest), image, note }]. image is relative to notionRoot (the Notion research captures beside parity-plan/, never committed). The comparator shows it next to the web and desktop captures of the same state, scene and interaction; it is a review aid, never a verdict.

environment.note: Font family is not compared (desktop uses the user font, default the platform UI font); text widths are not compared.

valueForms.number: literal px (or unitless for fontWeight, opacity, count)
valueForms.token path: a dotted path into tokens.json; a color.* token resolves per theme to resolved.light / resolved.dark (resolved.desktopDark for the desktop dark state when present, see OD-2); a shadow.* token to its per-theme list
valueForms.ref:<css-var>: a web semantic colour variable; resolves through the tokens.json color entries of kind "ref" with that ref (they must agree)
valueForms.{ \"calc\": \"expr\" }: numbers, token paths, $<parity-id>.<metric> (measured, same instance scope) and $self.<metric>, + - * / ( ), clamp(lo, x, hi), min, max, round

measurement: Definitions per metric and client: VISUAL-PARITY.md §3.3. Insets (left/right/top/bottom/center*) are against relativeTo; padding* is the inset from the element box to the union of its own __parts (or of `content`); gapToNext is the gap to the next parity sibling along gapAxis (default x); childGap is every gap between consecutive parity children along the main axis; pitch is the distance between the tops of consecutive instances.
idConvention: web data-parity-id="<id>", desktop ParityId(<id>) = KeyedSubtree with ValueKey<String>(<id>). Parts: <id>__icon, <id>__label, <id>__chevron, <id>__pill, <id>__band, <id>__dot, <id>__title, <id>__divider, <id>__footer, <id>__drag-icon. appliesTo globs: * matches [a-z0-9-]* and never "__".
